CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   C. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Melody.

2. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.
   C. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.

3. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

4. Best practice when working on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.

5. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.
   B. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.
   D. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   B. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   D. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. Best practice when working on Storytelling and Animation: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Storytelling and Animation.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Storytelling and Animation.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Storytelling and Animation.
   D. Practise Storytelling and Animation with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

9. Best practice when working on Javelin and Sculpture: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Javelin and Sculpture.
   B. Practise Javelin and Sculpture with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Javelin and Sculpture.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Javelin and Sculpture.

10. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

11. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   B. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.

12. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. The ticket price
   C. Only the volume
   D. Only the costume

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Javelin and Sculpture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Handball and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Descant Recorder and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

3. D — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

4. C — Practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. D — Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. D — Practise Storytelling and Animation with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. D — Red, blue, and yellow

9. B — Practise Javelin and Sculpture with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. C — Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. B — Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
